payload.blocks: Landing phase 6 (reviewed, green, branch work-data-model/p06c) and so phase 7. Phase 5's data move waits on q-exu5x27hbq separately. Paths lands of plan files still work.
payload.headline: Phase 6 cannot land: main checkout holds an uncommitted orchestration-skeleton DISCUSSION.md edit

parts.cause: The file carries an uncommitted edit of the orchestration-skeleton shaper session. The land's sync to the remote tip would rewrite it, so origin likely holds a newer commit of that file than the checkout (for example a shaper land that pushed but did not advance the checkout). The lead cannot fetch, touch another session's file or read the host source.

options.cost: A few minutes of the supervisor or owner.
options.does: The supervisor gets the orchestration-skeleton shaper to land (or discard) its pending DISCUSSION.md edit; if a push already went out, run fgos git recover.
options.gain: Clears the checkout for every branch land, not only this plan's.
options.harm: Touches another session's work in progress.
options.label: Shaper lands its edit

options.does: Nothing now; the lead retries the land on its next wake.
options.harm: Phase 6 and 7 stay blocked for as long as the shaper keeps the file dirty; other plans' branch lands are likely blocked the same way.
options.label: Wait for its next round

parts.recommendation: Have the supervisor make the orchestration-skeleton shaper land its pending edit (and run fgos git recover if the checkout is behind a pushed commit); the lead then lands p06c at once.

scope.allows: Clearing that one dirty file through its owning session and recovering the checkout.
scope.forbids: Discarding the shaper's edit without its session's consent, or any change to this plan's code.

parts.what: fgos land work-data-model/p06c (and p06b before it) is refused at prepare with main-checkout-dirty-overlap: docs/discussions/orchestration-skeleton/DISCUSSION.md is dirty in the main checkout and is written by the land. 8 tries from 20:00 to 20:40 failed the same way; a branch rebuilt on the trunk tip (1b83a6b72) is refused too, so it is not a stale-base effect. The branch itself touches only 6 Rust files.
